# Appziio

> Appziio is a software development company based in Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded by Farish and Maithreyan, Appziio builds SaaS platforms, e-commerce solutions, Android applications, and modern web applications for startups and enterprises. Registered under Udyam (MSME, Govt. of India) as a Micro enterprise in Services.

## Core Services

- [SaaS Development](https://appziio.com/about): Multi-tenant web applications, authentication, billing, dashboard interfaces, and backend APIs built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Supabase.
- [E-Commerce Platforms](https://appziio.com/about): Custom digital storefronts, inventory management, checkout integration, and custom e-commerce experiences.
- [Android App Development](https://appziio.com/about): Cross-platform and native mobile apps built using Flutter and Kotlin, optimized for performance and Play Store distribution.
- [Website Development](https://appziio.com/about): High-performance, SEO-optimized, highly responsive modern web applications built with Next.js, React, and Tailwind CSS.

## Company Details

- **Founders**: Farish Sharif & Maithreyan
- **Location**: Vellore, Tamil Nadu, India (632001)
- **Legal Status**: MSME Udyam Registered Micro Enterprise (Govt. of India)
- **Primary Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Supabase, Flutter, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Vercel
- **Contact Email**: info@appziio.com
- **Website**: https://appziio.com
